chapter.verse: Pasian aw, ka thungetna hong ngai in la, kong thumna panin nangmah bu kei in!
Kei lam hong nga in la, hong dawng in; ka gimna in kei hong zo hi.
Migilote’ sukcipna, galte’ huging in kei hong gimsak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in kei tungah haksatna hong tun’ uh a, amaute in hehna tawh keimah hong galbawl ding uh nuamsa uh hi.
Ka sungah ka lungsim na mahmah a, sih ding launate kei tung hong tung zo hi.
Launa leh liin’na ka tung hong tung a, launa in kei hong vukcip hi.
Hih bangin ka ci hi, “Vakhu bangin kha nei hi leng pawh! Ka leengkhia ding a, nuam takin ka om hithiat ding hi;
hi taktak hi, gamla pek-ah ka vakthap ding a, gam sungah ka giak ding hi.
Gensiatna huihpi leh huih husiate panin bukna ka zongpak ding hi,"
Topa aw, amau’ ngaihsutnate suksiatsak in la, a pau uh kilamdangsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh khua sungah ngongtatna leh kam kiselna ka mu hi.
Sun leh zanin amaute kulhpi tungah kot paipai uh a, a sungah siatna leh haksatnate om-in,
a lakah siatna om hi; sumzuak sumleina mun panin kisukcipna leh khemna veng lo hi.
Kei hong phin, galte hi lo hi—hi leh ka thuak zo ding hi; kei hong galbawl mi in kei hong mudah mi hi lo hi;—hi leh amah ka pel thei hi.
Ahih hangin, ka kikimpih, ka kikholhpih, ka lawm theih mahmah, nangmah na hi hi.
Kamkhum tawh i kihoho ngei hi; Pasian’ inn sungah i kikhawl khawm ngei hi.
Sihna amau tungah tungsak in; Leinuai-ah a hingtangin amaute paisuksak in la, amaute launa lianpi tawh a han uh ah paisak in.
Ahih hangin keimah in Pasian tungah ka ko a, Topa in kei hong hon ding hi.
Nitak, zingsang leh sunin, ka gimna leh ka thumna ka gen hi, amah in ka aw hong za ding hi.
Amah in ka galsimna-ah kei hong honin, a muan’huai munah hong koih ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh keimah do dingin mi tampi kigual deudau uh hi.
Taanglai pan-a kumpi-a a kikoih Pasian in za ding a, amaute niamkhiat ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in thukham zui lo uh a, Pasian zahtak lo uh hi.
Ka kikholhpih mi in ama lawmte langpangin a khut zan a, a thuciamna palsat hi.
Ama kampau in thawhbat sangin nelzaw a, ahi zongin a lung sungah muhdahna om hi; a kammalte sathau sangin nipzaw a, ahi zongin tuate pen namsau hiam mahmah tawh kibang hi.
Topa tungah na vangik nga in, amah in nang hong huh ding hi; amah in thumante cik mahin a kilingsak ngei kei ding hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian aw, dum thukpenna munah nangmah in amaute na lawnsuk ding a, mi a thatte leh mikhemte pen amau nuntak ding zah lang hing lo ding hi. Ahih hangin keimah in nang kong muang ding hi.
